description: Hold one draft from find_opportunities for the connected user for 10 minutes, so no other member posts the same reply. Call it when the user has PICKED a draft and is about to post — not to reserve work for later. Returns the draft text and `held_until`. One hold at a time: if the user already holds another draft, this fails with too_many_holds — submit that one (submit_participation) or release it (release_opportunity) first. Calling it again on the same draft restarts the 10 minutes. already_reserved means another member holds it or it was just claimed: offer another draft. Free. Never post for the user: they edit, approve and post it from their own account.
name: hold_opportunity
title: Hold a draft while the user posts it
